title: Logotype / General positioning
slide_intent: Assign a signature a clear place and scale because a visible brand cue should survive different format shapes.
strategic_value: Bold placement can make Duolingo recognizable in both portrait and landscape communications.
demonstration: Four layout examples accompany guidance to use a corner or central vertical axis and avoid a logotype narrower than one-third of the canvas.
practical_value: Choose an allowed placement and check size relative to the composition.

content_islands.name: Layout comparisons
content_islands.spec: Arrange the four placement examples in a two-column grid within the left panel.

content_islands.name: Placement and scale rules
content_islands.spec: Place the digital/print scope and corner, axis and width instructions in the right column.

reference_purposes.Application: The examples and copy identify corners or the central vertical axis as logo positions.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source says to avoid a logotype smaller than one-third of canvas width.
reference_purposes.Intent: The instructions encourage prominent scale with the stated aim of a bold, proud presentation.

ingredient.name: Logotype placement
ingredient.role: Make identification prominent within a composition.
ingredient.application: Use one of four corners or center on the vertical axis; avoid width below one-third of the canvas.
ingredient.scope: Historical archived guidelines. General historical digital and print guidance for portrait and landscape formats.
